notes.title: Circus of TimTim - Day 2 Patch (v1.2.5) is now LIVE! Lore, Languages & More!
notes.notes:
Hi!

We wish to thank everyone again for your support as we really appreciate it. We loved seeing all the videos and comments and feedbacks that you have to give us and we will apply those feedbacks to further improve the game.

Patch v1.2.5:


 We have added some lore into the game that explains what happened in the circus and why there are big mascot puppets trying to kill you. Can you find them all?
 Some more random-generated locations have been added for the objectives.
 Fixed some more bugs and issues.
 Improved optimization and texture sizes
 Improved once again the enemies AI system.
 The PAUSE function now works instead of not pausing the game.
 Updated some more props into the game.
 Updated some random events in the game to scare the player at random interventions.
 Updated some sounds, clips and audio.
 Arrange some spelling mistakes in credits and such.
 Updated some events to be more effective in the game.
 Added the GREEK language into the game.
 Added the INDONESIAN language into the game.


We are also working on a new game mode which opens up more replayability within the game, alongside also with new enemies that we are working on. Stay tuned!

If you have any issues, suggestions or feedback be sure to report it to us and we’ll try to fix it as soon as possible. Also feel free to join in our discord: https://discord.com/invite/MsaaK93hWw

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Circus of TimTim - Day 1 Patch (v1.2.4) is now LIVE! Replayability & More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your interest and support in our first game Circus of TimTim! We will be taking your feedback into consideration as we want to improve with your help. We have updated the game and fixed some issues that we were told about.


Patch v1.2.4:


 We have added a system that randomize the objectives across the map, opening a door for replayability in the game. We will also be focusing on adding more enemies next and more randomized events.
 Some Tickets now will spawn differently on each playthrough of the game.
 Fixed some bugs and issues such as enemy getting stuck.
 Improved optimization on the game.
 Improved the enemy's AI system in the game.
 Added more hiding spots and lockers across the map.
 Updated some props within the game.
 Added hints that will show on what you need to do in certain parts.
 Updated some sounds and audio.
 Updated some events to be more effective in the game.



If you have any issues that still occur or new issues (especially with bugs, the optimization, and the lag) be sure to report it to us and we’ll try to fix it as soon as possible.

Thank you very much.
